description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and max activation value for three different residual types. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.  The first line, representing “attn_residual”, is dashed and colored blue; it begins at approximately 100 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 120 until layer 5, then declines to approximately 80 at layer 21. The second line, representing “ffn_output”, is dotted and colored orange; it begins at approximately 200 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1400 until layer 18, and then declines to approximately 200 at layer 21. The third line, representing “ffn_residual”, is solid and colored red; it begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1450 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1450 until layer 18, and then declines to approximately 0 at layer 21.
